We know very little about the climate on our planet but one thing we know for sure is that climate is a variable not a constant, it has been changing for billions of years before us and it will keep changing. We have less than 100 years of reliable weather records and people talk about record heat and rain like it's the end of the world. The climate is not acting weird, we are acting weird because we assume to have an understanding of an enormously complex system while in reality our understanding of it is very poor, and then we freak out because the system does something we did not anticipate.
